baseline_models.focus_anchor: The seeing verb at word 2 is followed by the event noun at word 3 and its modifier at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Direct perception is counted as one bounded episode and then related to a prior episode as another or later occurrence.

activation_trace.role: Eye-seeing or insight supplies the act of apprehension.
A single descent or episode gives the perception a countable event boundary.
A later or other member supplies recurrence without requiring identity of circumstances.

changed_reading.before: He saw him or it again.
changed_reading.after: He apprehended him or it in another discrete occurrence of descent, with the recurrence itself foregrounded.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The seeing verb at word 2 can encode facing within visible range, while word 3 names descent and settlement.
baseline_models.mechanism: Visibility and alighting combine into an encounter: one party enters a shared perceptual range by descending or settling, and the encounter recurs under other conditions.

activation_trace.role: Mutual visibility and facing turn seeing into relational presence rather than a detached image.
Descent and alighting supply the motion by which perceptual range is entered.
Otherness marks this encounter as related to, but not collapsed into, the first.

changed_reading.before: A viewer registered the same object twice.
changed_reading.after: A second encounter occurred when the seen party again came into shared range by alighting.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The seeing root at word 2 includes dream vision, and the event noun at word 3 can count a single episode.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse can initially sustain an inward or dream-like recurrence alongside sensory seeing: a second bounded visionary episode rather than necessarily a second ordinary optical exposure.

activation_trace.role: Dream vision supplies an inward mode of seeing that remains lexically available.
The one-episode branch bounds the inward event as a recurrence.
The later or other branch relates this episode to an earlier one.

changed_reading.before: The line reports only ordinary eyesight.
changed_reading.after: The line can also carry a second inward visionary episode, pending contextual calibration of the faculty involved.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 3 can name a station, lodging, or rank, and word 4 qualifies it as another.
baseline_models.mechanism: The event noun is spatialized: the seeing occurs at another station or stopping-place, so changed location or rank matters as much as simple numerical repetition.

activation_trace.role: Perception anchors the proposed station to the actual act of seeing.
Station, lodging, or rank supplies a situated scene rather than a bare temporal adverb.
Another or later member differentiates this station from an earlier one.

changed_reading.before: The adverbial phrase merely means a second time.
changed_reading.after: The seeing is situated at another alighting-station or level, allowing spatial and rank change to coexist with recurrence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The seeing root at word 2 includes making something seen, while the descent root at word 3 includes placing something in its proper order.
baseline_models.mechanism: Without changing the surface syntax into a causative, the branch pair activates a disclosure model in which perception depends on an appearance being placed into an apprehensible configuration.

activation_trace.role: Showing or making seen supplies the latent disclosure side of perception.
Placement into a fitting position supplies configuration of the appearance.
Otherness makes the configured disclosure a renewed but nonidentical presentation.

changed_reading.before: The observer independently catches sight of an already available object.
changed_reading.after: The observer sees through another configured presentation, as though the appearance has again been placed within apprehensible order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah brackets the focus with falling language, first for a celestial body and later for a cast-down city. That pressure makes the focus descent oscillate between controlled alighting and an event that overwhelms those upon whom it comes.

activation_trace.role: Descent and settlement retain the controlled alighting pole in the focus.
A severe event descending upon people supplies the focus root's live overwhelming pole.
Falling into a depth opens a downward-motion register before the focus.
The repeated fall image near the close gives downward motion a catastrophic extreme.

structural_cues: The same fall root occurs at 53:1 and 53:53, on opposite sides of the focus.
The focus uses an event noun rather than an unqualified directional verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two falls and the focus inventory's alighting/calamity contrast; I infer a controlled-versus-overwhelming motion spectrum. A live alternative is that the falls merely frame the surah and do not color this noun.

changed_reading.before: Another descent is a neutral, benign repetition.
changed_reading.after: Another descent is an arrival whose ordered alighting remains legible against the live possibility of overpowering fall.

context_deltas.mechanism: Elevation, approach, suspension from above, measured range, and hidden transfer form a motion-to-contact sequence. The focus episode becomes another controlled lowering into a range where perception and communication can occur.

activation_trace.role: Descent and alighting name the focus event that the preceding choreography explains.
Facing within visible range supplies the relational endpoint of the lowering.
Height and elevation establish the motion's upper origin.
Nearness supplies closure of distance.
Suspension or lowering from above supplies the directional transition.
A bow-based measure turns proximity into a bounded range rather than vague closeness.
Hidden imparting of knowledge supplies the communicative result of entering range.

structural_cues: 53:7-10 proceeds from height through approach and measured nearness to communication.
The focus follows this sequence with a counted recurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies each spatial and communicative step; I supply the arrow from lowering to perceptual contact and transfer. The alternative is a sequence of distinct scene details rather than one controlled approach mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The second sighting is detached from how visibility became possible.
changed_reading.after: The second sighting is another controlled crossing from height into measured perceptual and communicative range.

context_deltas.mechanism: An inward faculty, dispute, ocular nondeviation, boundedness, and visible signs turn seeing into calibrated testimony. The context does not erase eye/insight plurality; it makes their agreement, discipline, and evidential object the point.

activation_trace.role: Eye-seeing or insight leaves both perceptual channels available in the focus.
Dream or inward vision preserves the non-ordinary perceptual possibility under calibration.
The heart as inwardly kindled faculty supplies internal registration of what was seen.
Sharp verbal contest makes the sighting answerable as testimony.
Ocular deviation or fatigue supplies the failure mode explicitly denied.
Physical eyesight identifies the outward faculty being disciplined.
Exceeding a limit supplies the overreach explicitly excluded from perception.
An evident sign shifts attention from spectacle to what the sight discloses.

structural_cues: 53:11 denies inward falsification; 53:17 denies outward deviation and excess.
The dispute in 53:12 is followed by the focus recurrence and then by sight of signs in 53:18.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two named faculties, denied failure modes, dispute, and signs; I infer a cross-calibrated witness. A live alternative is that heart and eye name successive emphases rather than an evidentiary coordination.

changed_reading.before: The verse asserts a private second visual impression.
changed_reading.after: The verse records a recurrent, contested witness whose inward registration and outward gaze agree without deviation or excess, while sensory and inward modes still coexist.

context_deltas.mechanism: Presence at an endpoint, a sheltered garden, a gathering refuge, and a covering layer convert the focus descent into alighting at a threshold. Arrival enables encounter, but covering prevents nearness from becoming exhaustive visibility.

activation_trace.role: Station or lodging supplies the focus event's situated stopping-place.
Provision prepared for an arriving guest adds a hosted-arrival possibility.
Near presence locates the alighting rather than leaving it abstract.
A terminal limit supplies the threshold at which the arrival comes to rest.
A garden hidden by its growth supplies sheltered, partially concealed space.
Joining a gathering refuge supplies reception and enclosure at the station.
A cover rising over and concealing something limits what the near witness can master.

structural_cues: The locative expression is repeated across 53:14-15 before the covering clause in 53:16.
Endpoint, refuge, and covering immediately follow the focus event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies location, endpoint, refuge, and cover; I infer that they describe the functional landing-site of the focus episode. The alternative is that they are backdrop after a purely temporal second sighting.

changed_reading.before: Another descent means only another motion downward.
changed_reading.after: It is another lodged encounter at a terminal refuge, where arrival and hospitality coexist with irreducible concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated seeing constructions move from witnessed perception to alerting questions, a challenge about seeing the unseen, and future public visibility. The focus is therefore one controlled node in a grammar of who may see, claim sight, demand recognition, or be made to see.

activation_trace.role: Direct seeing or insight anchors the focal witness within the wider grammar.
The alerting tell-me formula converts seeing language into a demand for judgment.
A second alerting question extends seeing from report to moral inspection.
Seeing or insight becomes a challenged claim when paired with unseen knowledge.
Making something seen supports the passive future exposure of human striving.

structural_cues: The root recurs in direct, interrogative, epistemically challenged, and passive constructions.
The focus is the only recurrence explicitly counted as another episode.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the recurring constructions and showing branch; I infer a distributed evidentiary grammar in which agency over visibility changes. The alternative is ordinary rhetorical repetition without a systematic contrast of access.

changed_reading.before: The focus verb is an isolated claim of sight.
changed_reading.after: The focus verb marks authorized access within a larger economy of challenged claims, demanded recognition, and eventual public showing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later discourse contrasts what is sent down with compelling warrant against conjecture lacking reality-correspondence. That contrast activates the focus descent as evidentiary delivery: the repeated perception matters because its disclosure arrives with authority, not because unusual seeing is self-validating.

activation_trace.role: Perception supplies the witness that requires epistemic classification.
Sending down and delivering supplies the focus event's latent authorization channel.
The same delivery branch is explicitly tied to the absence of warrant for rival names.
Compelling proof supplies the criterion by which a delivered disclosure differs from invention.
Doubt and imagining supply the rival mode of unsupported projection.
Disclosure of a thing to a knower supplies the positive epistemic state denied to the rivals.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the standard conjecture cannot replace.

structural_cues: 53:23 grammatically negates any sent-down authority for the named rivals.
53:28 opposes conjecture to truth after denying knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, proof, conjecture, knowledge, and truth; I infer that the focus descent participates in the authorized side of this contrast. The alternative is that the later polemic concerns only rival names and does not retrospectively classify the vision.

changed_reading.before: A second extraordinary sight is sufficient evidence by itself.
changed_reading.after: The second episode is a delivered disclosure whose evidentiary force comes from authorized arrival and reality-correspondence, in contrast to projected naming.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later uses make otherness relational in several ways: another member after an ordinal, the latter against the first, and another emergence brought into being. The focus modifier can therefore mark re-instantiation in a changed mode, not merely the numeral two.

activation_trace.role: A single episode supplies the repeatable unit that can be instantiated again.
A later or other member leaves room for altered mode as well as sequence.
Otherness after an ordinal shows relational classification rather than a bare second count.
The latter member supplies one pole of a first-and-later relation.
Beginning and precedence supply the corresponding first pole.
Bringing something newly into being supplies transformation within recurrence.
Another or later member explicitly qualifies the new emergence.

structural_cues: At 53:20 the modifier follows an ordinal third; at 53:25 it is paired with the first; at 53:47 it modifies a new emergence.
The focus likewise pairs a countable event noun with the modifier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three relational environments for otherness; I infer that recurrence may preserve identity while changing mode. The alternative is the simpler chronological sense another time in the focus.

changed_reading.before: The second occurrence duplicates the first except for date.
changed_reading.after: The other episode re-instantiates the encounter in a changed station or mode, related to the first without being a mere copy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from the focus seeing root to a narration root, while the surface verb strongly favors seeing. It remains anchored to word 2 and is activated by later delivered-news, written-record, and renewed-report branches. Render only as a report-bearing echo of witnessed experience, never as a replacement translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split inventory attached to the focus verb at word 2 includes relaying reports, and word 3 bounds the relayable experience as an episode.

activation_trace.role: Relaying reports or poetry supplies a form-distant transmission channel attached by the packet's split mapping.
A single episode supplies the bounded experience available for transmission.
News that arrives and is delivered activates movement from event to report.
A written sheet supplies durable inscription of transmitted knowledge.
Speech renewed as news supplies the public-report endpoint of the witnessed episode.

changed_reading.before: The recurrence remains an incommunicable private sight.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the witnessed episode is also a relayable report carried from encounter into remembered, written, and publicly renewed telling.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus descent root's explicit seminal-discharge branch through later drop, emission, and new-emergence language. It remains anchored to words 3-4 and produces a coherent material analogy of transfer followed by formation. Render as a cross-domain generative analogy, not as a lexical claim that the focus noun denotes semen or reproduction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus event noun at word 3 has an emission branch, and its modifier at word 4 marks another resulting phase.

activation_trace.role: Seminal discharge supplies the material image of a released deposit.
Another or later member supplies the phase that follows generative transfer.
A clear drop extending through the semen sense supplies concentrated generative material.
Semen from which form is apportioned supplies the transfer-to-formation link.
Bringing a thing into being supplies emergence as the result of the deposit.
The later or other branch explicitly marks the resulting emergence as another phase.

changed_reading.before: Descent is only locomotion through space.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the episode is a generative deposit: disclosure enters, takes form, and yields another mode of emergence in the witness.

strongest_changes: The descent became a controlled lowering from height into measured perceptual and communicative range.
The sight became cross-calibrated testimony of inward and outward faculties rather than an isolated optical claim.
The episode became an alighting at a terminal refuge where nearness remains covered and non-exhaustive.
Otherness expanded from simple repetition to re-instantiation at another station or in another mode.
summary.what_was_special: The three focus roots sustained several coexisting mechanisms: repeated perception, mutual encounter, inward vision, stationing, configured disclosure, authorized evidence, transformed recurrence, and two contained report/material echoes. Context sharpened these without forcing one final referent or perceptual mode.
remaining_uncertainties: The pronoun's referent is not identified by the focus line alone.
The event noun can still distribute weight among one-time descent, alighting, station, and manner.
The heart-and-eye sequence supports coordination but does not conclusively choose sensory sight over inward vision.
The narration split and generative-emission readings remain deliberately form-distant analogies.
Several causal arrows come from sequence and branch interaction rather than explicit syntax.
